Done — pushed to the author's branch on PR [#996](https://github.com/getnao/nao/pull/996).

**What happened / why it just worked:**

- The PR is cross-repo (from `florian-drouet`'s fork) but has **"Allow edits by maintainers"** enabled (`maintainerCanModify: true`), which grants you push access to their branch.
- `gh pr checkout` had already set the branch config so a plain `git push` targets the fork:
  - `branch.feature/add-gitlab-support.pushremote` → `git@github.com:florian-drouet/nao.git`
  - `branch.feature/add-gitlab-support.merge` → `refs/heads/feature/add-gitlab-support`
- Push result: `73665657..11fb7c83` on `florian-drouet/nao:feature/add-gitlab-support` (18 commits, a `Merge main` + your migration commits).

For future PRs checked out this way, the same one-liner works:

```bash
git push
```

If you ever need to be explicit (e.g. config got reset), the equivalent is:

```bash
git push git@github.com:florian-drouet/nao.git HEAD:feature/add-gitlab-support
```

One caveat: maintainer push access only works while the fork's default branch permission allows it — it breaks if the PR is from an org-owned fork, which isn't the case here.
